entries.note: The order is in the system; the parcel has not reached the warehouse yet.

entries.wording: 您的货物在仓库【…】已经打包完成
entries.english: Your goods were packed at the warehouse …
entries.note: The Baltimore warehouse has the parcel and packs it.

entries.wording: 您的货物在仓库【…】正在集货，等待送往机场
entries.english: Your goods are being consolidated at the warehouse …, waiting to go to the airport

entries.wording: 您的货物在仓库【…】已经完成装箱
entries.english: Your goods were boxed at the warehouse …

entries.wording: 您的货物在仓库【…】已经完成集货，转交航空公司
entries.english: Your goods were consolidated at the warehouse … and handed to the airline

entries.wording: 您的货物已经到达中国，正在海关清关
entries.english: Your goods arrived in China and are in customs clearance

entries.note: Customs released the parcel; SF Express takes it next.

entries.wording: 顺丰速运 已收取快件
entries.english: SF Express picked up the parcel
entries.note: SF Express's own scans are relayed from here on.

entries.wording: 快件在【…】完成分拣,准备发往 【…】
entries.english: The parcel was sorted at …, leaving for …

entries.wording: 已转【顺丰速递】派送，运单号 …
entries.english: Handed to SF Express for delivery, waybill …
entries.note: The waybill is SF Express's; the result gives it as the delivery tracking number.

entries.wording: 已签收(丰巢签收),感谢使用顺丰,期待再次为您服务（主单总件数：1件）
entries.english: Signed for (Hive Box locker), thank you for using SF Express (pieces on the waybill: 1)
entries.note: SF Express's delivery, through a Hive Box locker.
